note: Declarative manifest for the shakedown-LITE profile — the repeatable sub-hour scripted floor between full post-sprint rounds (docs/shakedown.md, 'Profiles: lite vs full'). It is consumed by run-shakedown-profile.mjs (which composes the per-tier case sets and drives the existing run-live-shakedown-matrix.sh + shakedown-scorecard.mjs) and by shakedown-scorecard.mjs (which reads requiredTiers/requiredCoverageIds/capabilityMatrixCaseId to compute the lite attestation). Nothing here forks the matrix logic: it selects cases by STABLE case id (never catalog position) and reuses the matrix sweep's signal-safe tier restore. Non-goal: lite never substitutes for the full post-sprint round.
description: Sub-hour scripted shakedown floor for out-of-band feature pushes: preflight verify gates, ~10 persisted-state smoke surfaces on one target, and the capability-gate matrix + tier tool-conformance evidence at all three tiers.

smoke.note: ~10 persisted-state smoke surfaces, selected by STABLE case id (never catalog position). They run once, at the baseline tier subset; each proves persisted state (turn records / Postgres rows / owner files), never reply text. capabilityMatrixCaseId is appended to every tier's set by the runner and is not listed here.
